entries.test: Public evaluations of AI comprehension and documented instances of AI replacing human jobs available by October 2022 would test both parts.
entries.note: The claim concerns capabilities and displacement as of publication, not today.

entries.test: Public records of driverless commercial trucking outside limited pilots and AI replacing radiologists by October 2022 would test the normalized claim.
entries.note: “Every truck I know” is narrower than a universal claim about truck drivers. The radiologist clause is categorical.
“Possible” and “may yet materialize” assert possibility, not a firm outcome.

entries.test: Public demonstrations available by October 2022 of AI learning diverse unfamiliar tasks from comparably small amounts of data would test the asserted absence of childlike learning.
entries.note: The surrounding examples establish broad, flexible learning as the comparison.

entries.test: Public evaluations of October 2022 AI systems across the broad learning, reasoning, language, and practical tasks humans perform would test whether a viable competitor existed.
entries.note: The comparison concerns general competence, not superiority on a narrow task.

entries.test: LeCun’s public tweets and documented capabilities and limitations of convolutional networks would test the attributed claim and Marcus’s rejection of it.
entries.note: The quoted position belongs to LeCun; Marcus explicitly endorses its negation.

entries.test: Public comparisons of assistance systems and full-job automation would show whether leaving tasks to humans reduces the capabilities and engineering effort required.
entries.note: Marcus supplies a causal explanation for the comparative difficulty.

entries.test: Public demonstrations available by October 2022 of machines interpreting and applying tax codes sufficiently to replace accountants would test the claim.
entries.note: The accountant example makes clear that “read” means understand and apply, not merely process text.

entries.test: Public descriptions of radiologists’ duties and comparative evaluations of convolutional networks on imaging, patient-history reasoning, and unstructured clinical text would test the claim.
entries.note: The normalization drops the explicit “in some cases” qualification on radiologists’ additional duties.

entries.test: Public radiology job requirements compared with the functions performed by scan-reading AI would establish whether scan reading covers the entire job.
entries.note: This is Marcus’s own embedded tweet.

entries.test: Public employment and clinical deployment records would show whether AI fully displaced radiologists before January 1, 2033.
entries.note: The bet concerns full displacement of the profession, not assistance or isolated job losses.

entries.test: Public evaluations separating scan interpretation from other radiology duties would establish whether success on scans alone demonstrates competence across the whole job.
entries.note: He rejects an inference from partial success; he does not assert that AI can never perform the remaining tasks.

entries.test: Research and system demonstrations public by October 2022 would show whether evidence supported an imminent full radiologist replacement using existing scan-reading techniques.
entries.note: This asserts an absence of evidence at publication, rather than a dated prediction of failure.

entries.test: The study’s reported results and methods would establish the correlation coefficient and whether its design demonstrated anything beyond an association.
entries.note: “Hardly decisive” is evaluative, but the numerical and methodological assertions have a clear empirical test.

entries.test: The paper’s original variance explanation and statistical methods would establish whether squaring its reported R of 0.5 yields the relevant explained variance of 25%.
entries.note: The interpretation must be checked against the study’s actual statistical setup.

entries.test: The study’s methods and results would show whether it established shared internal mechanisms between GPT-2 and the brain beyond correlated responses.
entries.note: The preceding discussion supplies the meaning of “direct link”: evidence of functioning in the same way.

entries.test: Public capability and safety evaluations of AlphaStar, LLMs, and other available October 2022 systems on domestic robot tasks would test whether a viable general controller existed.
entries.note: This is a present capability claim that can be tested through demonstrations, despite its hypothetical installation framing.

entries.test: Public demonstrations of safe, useful domestic humanoid robots operating without general intelligence, together with evaluations of available October 2022 controllers, would test both clauses.
entries.note: In context, “domestic robots” means safe and useful household assistants, not merely humanoid hardware.
